defs.def: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body not active 睡；睡觉；入睡

ex.s: Every animal sleeps, but the reason for this has remained foggy.
ex.t: 父母应该只能基于有限的医疗或宗教原因选择退出。

ex.s: Well, while I was sleeping, Dad stopped for some petrol and Mum also got out to take photos, and you can guess the rest...
ex.t: 嗯，在我睡觉的时候，爸爸停下来加油，妈妈也下车拍照，后面的你们可以猜到……

ex.s: They put up their tent under the stars and go to sleep.
ex.t: 他们在星空下搭起帐篷睡觉。

ex.s: After Charlie had a heart attack, Tindale says, she was prepared to put him to sleep, but Farber’s treatments eased her dog’s suffering so much that she was able to keep him alive for an additional five months.
ex.t: Charlie心脏病发作后，Tindale说，她本准备让它安乐死，但Farber的治疗大大减轻了它的痛苦，让她又能让它多活了五个月。

ex.s: We were raised on books and computers, highways and cell phones, but now we were living in a village without running water or electricity It was easy for us to go to sleep at the end of the day feeling a little misunderstood.
ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.s: If you’re tired out by Friday night, sleeping in on Saturday could sound wonderful.
ex.t: 如果周五晚上你已经累了，周六睡个懒觉听起来会很美妙。

ex.s: She says these activities at bedtime can get kids all excited and make it hard for them to calm down and sleep.
ex.t: 她说这些睡前活动会让孩子兴奋起来，使他们很难平静下来入睡。

ex.s: Why do we dream？Scientists aren't completely sure,and they have diverse____11____ (idea)．Dreams might be a side effect of memory making.When you sleep,your brain sorts through everything ____12____ happened during the day，trying to link new experiences to old memories.As it ____13____ (connect) things，your brain tums them into a story,and you get a dream．
ex.t: 我们为什么会做梦？科学家也不完全确定，他们有各种各样的___11___（想法）。梦可能是记忆形成的副作用。当你睡觉时，大脑会梳理白天发生的每一件事___12___，试图把新经历和旧记忆联系起来。当它___13___（连接）事物时，大脑把它们变成了一个故事，于是你便做了个梦。

ex.s: They say it can play a big role in calming the brain enough to sleep．
ex.t: 他们说，它在让大脑平静下来、足以入睡方面能发挥很大作用。

ex.s: Similarly, when people go for a few days without sleeping, they get sick.
ex.t: 同样，人如果好几天不睡觉，就会生病。

ex.s: Campers, in my eyes, were people who enjoyed insect bites, ill-cooked meals, and uncomfortable sleeping bags.
ex.t: 在我眼中，露营者是那些喜欢蚊虫叮咬、半生不熟的食物和不舒服睡袋的人。

ex.s: They tolerate long, slow journeys to and from work on packed highways because they can work, entertain themselves or sleep on the ride, which encourages urban spread.
ex.t: 他们忍受在拥挤的高速公路上漫长而缓慢的上下班通勤，因为他们可以在途中工作、娱乐或睡觉，这促进了城市扩张。

ex.s: When lab rats are not allowed to sleep, they die within a month.
ex.t: 实验室里的老鼠如果不让睡觉，会在一个月内死亡。

ex.s: As the night wore on，people began to close their eyes，but the seats were so uncomfortable that only a very heavy sleeper could manage to get any____3____．The woman looked over at the man．He was still staring at her．She looked back at him with fire in her eyes．I was beginning to get____4____，too．
ex.t: 夜深了，人们开始闭上眼睛，但座位太不舒服，只有睡得很沉的人才能____3____睡着。那位女士看向男士，他还在盯着她。她用冒火的眼神回望他。我也开始变得____4____不安了。

ex.s: It’s about two sisters-Eri，a model who either won’t or can’t stop sleeping，and Mari, a young student .
ex.t: 它讲的是两姐妹——要么不愿要么不能停止睡觉的模特艾里，和年轻学生玛丽。

ex.s: Babies need a lot of rest: most of them sleep about 18 hours a day!
ex.t: 婴儿需要大量休息：他们中的大多数一天要睡大约18个小时！

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母从椅子上的短暂小睡中醒来，手指捋过波浪般的白发，望向窗外蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: They both fell   58   （sleep）while watching TV.
ex.t: 他们俩看电视时都   58  （sleep）睡着了。

ex.s: 37    We sleep in a tent, cooked over an open fire, and walked a long distance to take the shower and use the bathroom.
ex.t: 37    我们睡帐篷，在篝火上做饭，走很远的路去洗澡和上厕所。

ex.s: Why do teenagers go to sleep late according to Carskadon?
ex.t: 根据卡斯卡顿的说法，青少年为什么晚睡？

ex.s: One idea is that sleep helps us strengthen new memories.
ex.t: 同样地，当人们几天不睡觉时，他们会生病。

ex.s: We should also try to sleep well the night before.
ex.t: 我们也应该在前一天晚上尽量睡好。

ex.s: If you need a good night's sleep, choose a tea that helps you relax.
ex.t: 如果您需要睡个好觉，请选择一种有助于放松的茶。

ex.s: That night, I should not be able to sleep.
ex.t: 那天晚上，我应该睡不着了。

ex.s: To think he is sleeping on the streets tonight    26    he could have stolen the money and paid for a place to stay in.
ex.t: 想到他今晚睡在街上    26    他本可以偷了那笔钱来付住处的费用。

ex.s: 38   That’s a quarter-hour more you could be sleeping if you bought a coffee maker with a timer.
ex.t: 38   如果你买了一个带定时器的咖啡机，那你就可以多睡一刻钟了。

defs.def: to have enough beds for a particular number of people 可供 … 人睡觉；可供 … 人住宿

ex.s: ●   39   Studies found that people who woke up early for exercise slept better than those who exercised in the evening.
ex.t: ● ____39____研究发现早起锻炼的人比晚上锻炼的人睡得更好。

ex.s: The train moved on．The little boy was ____5____ awake on his mother's lap，but the woman dropped off to sleep．A moment later，he began to____6____the half-open window—one leg went over it．The man jumped up and ____7____the child just before he fell out．
ex.t: 火车继续前行。小男孩___5___醒着躺在母亲腿上，但女人睡着了。片刻后，他开始___6___那半开的车窗——一条腿已经跨了过去。男子跳起来，在孩子掉出去前___7___了他。

ex.s: “I [had] lost enough sleep over this,” says David Cox, the company's Western region vice president — and that was before the hospital mentioned the tree's distinguished origin.
ex.t: “我为此已经失眠够多了，”该公司西区副总裁David Cox说——而且那还是在医院提到这棵树显赫的来历之前。

ex.s: Most long-distance trains especially the sleeping car accommodations, sell out very quickly. ____36____ But no matter when you travel, it’s a good idea to make your reservations at least 90 days in advance.
ex.t: 大多数长途火车，尤其是卧铺车厢，很快就售罄。____36____ 但无论你何时出行，最好至少提前90天预订。

defs.def: the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is not active, and your mind is not conscious 睡觉；睡眠

ex.s: It is important for you to get about eight hours' sleep at night.
ex.t: 你每晚保证大约八小时的睡眠很重要。

ex.s: Coffee may cause sleep disturbance, especially when _________ in large amounts or after 2 pm.
ex.t: 咖啡可能导致睡眠障碍，尤其是当____或下午2点后大量____时。

ex.s: Keep your sleep/wake schedule on weekends.
ex.t: 保持周末的睡眠/唤醒作息。

ex.s: Get a sleep specialist.
ex.t: 去找睡眠专科医生。

ex.s: A better plan for sleep can help.
ex.t: 一个更好的睡眠计划会有帮助。

ex.s: Getting less sleep has become a bad habit for most American kids.
ex.t: 睡眠不足已经成为大多数美国孩子的坏习惯。

ex.s: What is the new National Sleep Foundation survey on?
ex.t: 新的国家睡眠基金会的调查是关于什么的？

ex.s: How many hours of sleep do 11-year-olds need every day?
ex.t: 11岁儿童每天需要多少小时的睡眠？

ex.s: “Sleep is the price we pay for learning,” says Giulio Tononi, who developed the idea.
ex.t: "睡眠是我们为学习付出的代价，"提出这一理念的朱利奥·托诺尼说。

ex.s: forcing patients into a state of deep sleep
ex.t: 把患者逼入深度睡眠状态

ex.s: American kids’ sleeping habits.
ex.t: 美国孩子的睡眠习惯。

ex.s: What does Russel think of sleep?
ex.t: Russel怎么看待睡眠？

ex.s: Exercise energizes you, so it is more difficult to relax and have a peaceful sleep when you are very excited.
ex.t: 运动会让你精力充沛，所以当你非常兴奋时，更难放松并获得安宁的睡眠。

ex.s: Your quality of sleep improves.
ex.t: 你的睡眠质量提高了。

ex.s: Learning problems and lack of sleep.
ex.t: 预防失眠的活动。

defs.def: a period of sleep 睡眠时间；一觉

ex.s: That’s why students do better in tests if they get a chance to sleep after learning.
ex.t: 这就是为什么学生在学习后如果有机会睡一觉，考试会考得更好。

ex.s: This is about making the shift from sedentary time to playtime, while ___27___ (protect) sleep.
ex.t: 这是关于从久坐时间转向玩耍时间，同时____27____（protect）睡眠。

ex.s: But the new National Sleep Foundation survey found that 35% of 10- to 12-year-olds get only seven or eight hours.
ex.t: 但新的国家睡眠基金会调查发现，35%的10至12岁儿童每晚睡眠不足推荐时间。

ex.s: 74  The synapses in the mice taken at the end of a period of sleep were 18 percent smaller than those taken before sleep, showing that the connections between neurons weaken while sleeping.
ex.t: 74  在一段睡眠结束时取出小鼠的突触比睡眠前取出的小18%，表明神经元之间的连接在睡眠时减弱。

ex.s: I turned up at the appointed hour for a dinner, only to find that no other guest____13____(arrive) and my hostess was still in her sleeping suit.
ex.t: 我按约定时间到达参加晚餐，却发现没有其他客人____13__（arrive），女主人还穿着睡衣。

ex.s: How much sleep you need depends a lot on your age.
ex.t: 你需要的睡眠时间很大程度上取决于你的年龄。

ex.s: We should have at least six to eight hours of sleep every day.
ex.t: 我们每天至少应该有六到八个小时的睡眠时间。

defs.def: the substance that sometimes forms in the corners of your eyes after you have been sleeping 眼屎

ex.s: He may also book you in a sleeping car that’s right next to the diner.
ex.t: 他也可能为你预订紧邻餐车的卧铺车厢。
